text:
Devin: Quick hypothetical ask — if you had to pick one permanent virtual background for all work video calls, where would it be?
Maya: Maldives overwater bungalow. sunlight + hammock = my soul. :beach:
Alex: A tiny, rainy Seattle coffee shop window seat. I can pretend I'm on a break. :coffee:
Samir: The treehouse I built as a kid. full of crooked shelves and stickers. pure nostalgia.
Priya: Hogwarts Great Hall. floating candles forever. :sparkles:
Jordan: An airport lounge with infinite outlets and free snacks. pragmatist vibes.
Maya: also low-key would take the 'cozy cabin by a fireplace' option. hot cocoa included. :heart:
Devin: ok these are all excellent. put an emoji reaction to vote? :raised_hands: (heart for Maldives, tada for Hogwarts, laugh for coffee shop, star for treehouse, claps for lounge)
Samir: voted :star:
Alex: voted :laughing:
Priya: voted :tada:
Jordan: voted :clap:
Maya: voted :heart:
design-bot: Poll summary: Maldives (1), Hogwarts (1), Coffee shop (1), Treehouse (1), Lounge (1) — tie!
Devin: surprise tie. love that we have eclectic tastes. :grin:
Alex: someone should make a 'Redwood dream backgrounds' pack. I'd use them all depending on mood.
Priya: @design could we actually get a small set? low-effort, high morale. :eyes:
Devin: If design makes it, cookies from Alex for the maintainer. :cookie:
Maya: bribe accepted.
Samir: also can we have a 'no background' policy day where everyone uses their real background and we do a plants tour? :seedling:
Devin: plants tour = yes. scheduled next Friday?
Jordan: count me in. I'll show off my sad succulent.
Priya: same, mine's thriving despite me.
Devin: cool — final note: thanks for the fun replies y'all. morale boost achieved. :sun_with_face:
